    - list:
      - listitem: "role=\"status\" with aria-live=\"polite\": screen readers hear each new phase and the done label once"
      - listitem: The spinner, the check and the label rolling out are aria-hidden; the shimmer copy has empty alt text, so labels are read once
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Eight thin accent-blue rays fade one after another, so the spinner turns without rotating
      - listitem: A darker band sweeps through the gray label while it works
      - listitem: On a new phase the old label rolls up and blurs out, the new one rolls in, and the chip glides to its new width
      - listitem: "Done: the spinner shrinks away while the check grows in and draws itself; the label stops shimmering"
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion the labels switch instantly and the spinner and shimmer stand still
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Sizes to its label; long phases stay on one line, so keep them short (two to four words)
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
